entities.name: Vadrok, the Thunder-Raptor
entities.description: The apex monster of the Raugrin triome on Ikoria, a massive catlike dragon with blue-white flame.

entities.name: Raugrin
entities.description: Triome of Ikoria ruled by Vadrok.

entities.name: Shroka Peaks
entities.description: Tall rocky columns in Raugrin where Vadrok nests.

entities.name: Ketria
entities.description: Triome partly in Vadrok's hunting grounds.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker who believes Vadrok has the longest hunting ground.

entities.name: Rielle
entities.description: Sage who alone knows the myth of the burned human sanctuary.

entities.name: Jirina Kudro
entities.description: Led survivors of Drannith to Vadrok's lair.

events.summary: Long ago Vadrok burned a human sanctuary to ash, erasing all memory of it.
events.quote: Long ago Vadrok burned a human sanctuary to ash.

events.summary: Jirina Kudro leads Drannith survivors into Vadrok's lair to lure in Lukka.
events.quote: Jirina Kudro led a column of survivors from the destroyed city of Drannith into Vadrok's lair

events.summary: Vadrok's flames strip Lukka's corrupted biomass, letting Vadrok extract the planeswalker, and it discards Lukka's corpse.
events.quote: the apex monster's magical flames stripped Lukka's corrupted biomass, letting Vadrok extract the planeswalker

events.summary: Vadrok turns to the citizens but declines to attack and departs.

relations.quote: Vadrok rules the skies of Raugrin.

relations.note: Battled and extracted him from his compleated form.
